fusions.name: Run It Down
fusions.desc: Looses a shot at a target at or below 30% health for 20 damage, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hunting Party
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once in a spread out to 7 tiles, each dealing 3 damage. It hits 8% harder for each ally near you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Long Leash
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further. A hound escort fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wounded Game
fusions.desc: You deal 12% more damage to enemies below 50% health.
